datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Guatemala on a monthly basis throughout 2012, classifying geographic units by food insecurity phase. The spatial data represents post-assessment classifications of food security conditions, typically driven by underlying hazards such as drought or conflict affecting food availability and access.
